verdict.rationale: Workable's official MCP server is documented for conversational, natural-language operation across recruiting (searching jobs, moving candidates through the pipeline, rating, managing offers) and HR self-service, but only through an external AI assistant acting as the MCP client. The Workable Agent automates sourcing and screening, yet no in-product natural-language command surface is documented. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command bar, operation without a third-party AI assistant, hands-on or independent corroboration of the conversational workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: create or approve leave requests conversationally
